summary: Of 114 genes labeled in the authors’ [Figure 2](https://insight.jci.org/articles/view/164178/figure/2), 110 had a registered DE result. All 110 agreed in direction for MKRN3 knockout versus wild type, and 28 met registered FDR < 0.05. Two paired directions came from labeled volcano points and 108 from sample heatmaps. The proposal passed the repository’s schema check.
openIssues: The public sources reviewed did not yield the full author DESeq2 table. Genome-wide concordance, exact effect magnitudes, and per-gene author P values and FDR remain unassessed.
SLIT1 and three figure-labeled Ensembl IDs lacked registered DE rows. The proposal limits closure to the selected-gene directional comparison.
